title: N=16/warp=1 packed NF4 K-tile screen
status: no-go for changing the current K=256 reference
configuration: Qwen2.5-3B NF4; RTX 4050 Laptop GPU; Triton 3.6.0; q_proj 2048x2048 and down_proj 2048x11008; M=1/2; 30 calls/sample; 7 alternating-order rounds
correctness: K=64/128/256 all passed finite rowwise singleton equality at M=1/2 for both projections; each K tile remains a distinct arithmetic schedule.
decision: K=128 is essentially tied for q_proj M=2 but slower on down_proj; K=64 is slower. Retain K=256. No new contract or whole-model run is justified.
limitations: Finite operator-only data on one GPU and two linear layers.
CUDA-event medians do not establish end-to-end speedup or statistical significance.
No held-out GSM8K data was used.
